title: Theory and Analysis of Atonal and Twelve-Tone Music
description:
Prerequisite: MUSC450; or permission of ARHU-School of Music department.
Jointly offered with MUSC461.
Credit only granted for: MUSC461 or MUSC661. An introduction to the advanced theoretical literature in atonal and twelve-tone music with an emphasis on analytical applications to music by prominent 20th-century composers.
